decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit builds directly on the firm's plural-component and fluid-handling expertise, so the firm can interpret results and improve it.
Like product A, this resin injection unit is close to the firm's existing plural-component and injection knowledge, supporting learning and retention.
Automatic airless spray guns are core spray application products within the firm's established gun and fluid-handling knowledge.
Manual airless spray guns are a standard part of the firm's spray application portfolio and well within its existing knowledge.
